title: Wojos Vanilla+: Arrows
description: Adds new utility arrow types made using strictly vanilla materials.
body:
Add some vanilla themed arrows to minecraft. Arrows are desiged to be utility arrows that I wish were in default Minecraft. It started with how I could create a vanilla themes torch arrow using glowberry vines and ended up adding a few additional arrows along with it. I tried to make them relativly balanced. If you have suggestions add it to the GITHUB!

## List of Arrows, Crafting Recipes, Default Stack Sizes, Misc Settings
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
### Weeping Vine Arrow (Rope Arrow)
Shoot a block to create a rope out of weeping vines that the player can climb up
- A valid flat surface must be above the impact location to mount the vine
- Stacks to 8 max by default
- Max weeping vine length is 7 by default *NOTE: It takes 7 Vines to craft so increasing this length in config means the user will be able to get infinate vines by making more arrows.*
- Can be picked up if invalid location is used
- Does 0 damage
- **Crafted (Shapeless) with 1:Arrow & 7:Weeping_Vines**

### Glowberry Arrow (Torch Arrow)
Use an existing cave lightsource to manually light up some caves
- A valid flat surface must be above the impact location to mount the vine as they grow down
- Stacks to 8 by default
- Max glowberry vine length is 1 by default
- Can be picked up if not used
- Does 0 damage
- **Crafted (Shapeless) with 1:Arrow, 1:Vine, 1:Glowberry**

### Ender Pearl Arrow (Teleport Arrow)
Shoot an ender pearl much further then you can throw them
- Stacks to 8 by default
- Can not be picked back up
- Does 0 Damage to target
- **Crafted (Shapeless) with 1:Arrow & 1:Ender_Pearl**

### Water Bucket Arrow (Water Source Block)
Shoot a water bucked to make a source block somewhere
- Stacks to a max of 1 by default
- Can only add water to empty areas
- Can not be picked back up
- Does 0 Damage to targets
- **Crafted (Shapeless) with 1:Arrow & 1:Water_Bucket**
</details>
